items.title: Wellington
items.placementTarget: Board map at 40° S, 160° E (New Zealand)
items.text: Wellington — Population 2, blue port city, sea lane extending northwest toward the Coral Sea / Sydney.

mechanics.trigger: Opened by reconning out of the Coral Sea (East Asia / Door 63 recon box: 2 unique red cards from a supply center)
mechanics.effect: Place Wellington on the board as a blue port city with population 2 connected by sea lane to the Coral Sea / Sydney. Wellington has no Player cards and no Infection cards (it is the location of the TOPAZ Lab clue, though no lab sticker is on this door itself; searching/visiting triggers follow Door 46 / lab rules).

summary: Map sticker placing Wellington (New Zealand, ~40° S, 160° E): blue port city, population 2, connected by a sea lane heading northwest. Has no Player or Infection cards.
